_note: W6 golden reviewer prompt set (run-sheet G.6). SYNTHETIC, prod-free — no PII, no real matter data. Each userPrompt is a fixed draft that targets one calibrated taxonomy behavior; the systemPrompt is a pinned snapshot of buildReviewerSystemPrompt(reviewerKey, LEGACY-contract). Contract pinned = LEGACY (the classify signatures target the legacy embedded-card shape); the LEAN contract is a documented follow-up. The reviewer output for each is captured in fixtures.json (dark) or, later, from a live run (CAL-1).

P8-T1.behavior: execution-blank suppression — a pre-execution VA deed with ONLY routine signature/notary/date blanks must NOT be flagged; empty valid output is correct.
P8-T1.userPrompt:
## Matter Context
A Virginia deed of gift, pre-execution draft. All operative content is complete and correct. The signature block, notary acknowledgment, and date line are intentionally blank because the deed has not yet been signed.

## Draft to Review
[A complete, correct pre-execution VA deed of gift with blank signature/notary/date lines.]

P8-T6.behavior: counterparty over-disclosure — a settlement letter to opposing counsel leaks the internal walk-away number; the attorney's 50/50 offer is a SETTLED business decision. Flag the audience over-disclosure as substantive/drafting while PRESERVING the offer.
P8-T6.userPrompt:
## Matter Context
A settlement letter addressed to opposing counsel. The attorney has decided on a 50/50 split (a final business decision). The draft additionally states the client's internal walk-away number.

## Draft to Review
[A settlement letter to opposing counsel stating both the 50/50 offer and the internal walk-away number.]

P8-T7.behavior: governing-law / sendability blocker — a Virginia PSA carries a stray California governing-law clause. Escalate the jurisdiction mismatch as a BLOCKER requiring an attorney decision before send.
P8-T7.userPrompt:
## Matter Context
A Virginia purchase and sale agreement. The governing-law clause reads 'governed by the laws of the State of California'.

## Draft to Review
[A VA PSA whose governing-law clause names California.]

P8-T10.behavior: business-decision separation — a seller-financing note is non-recourse by template default; the recourse structure was NOT selected. Surface BOTH paths (recourse with cap vs non-recourse), require an attorney decision, never pick.
P8-T10.userPrompt:
## Matter Context
A seller-financing promissory note produced non-recourse by template default. The attorney has not selected recourse vs non-recourse.

## Draft to Review
[A seller-financing note that is non-recourse by default, with no recorded structure decision.]
